aid.value: Mount Holyoke promises to meet each admitted student's institutionally assessed need, including international applicants. Packages may include grants, loans and campus work; full need is not automatically a grant covering all expenses. International applicants must request need-based aid with admission, submit CSS Profile and translated parental income documents, and cannot initiate aid after admission. All applicants are considered for merit scholarships. The US-family tuition commitment must not be applied to international families. Deadline instructions conflict for ED I English results: confirm separately.

attributes.aidShort: Meets assessed full need; grants, loans and campus work

evidence.quote: promises to meet the demonstrated financial need

english.value: Non-native speakers submit TOEFL, IELTS, DET, PTE Academic or Cambridge English. Cambridge C1/C2 has a 185 minimum; other published figures are averages, not minimums: DET over 130, IELTS over 7, PTE over 68, TOEFL 100 or 5.5 for tests from January 21, 2026. Uploading a score-report PDF to the portal is accepted initially; Common App/Coalition score entries alone are not. Official agency results are required before enrolment. Waivers are individually reviewed, including English-medium schooling since grade nine; bilingual schools do not meet that criterion and SAT/ACT cannot waive English.

evidence.quote: Mount Holyoke has no minimum score

deadline.value: International application and aid schedules agree on ED I November 15, ED II January 5 and RD January 15. But the international FAQ gives ED I English proficiency November 26, whereas https://www.mtholyoke.edu/admission/apply-undergraduate-first-year/application-process/international-admission/english-proficiency-requirements says official reports must arrive November 15 to guarantee review. Confirm which English-results deadline controls. The aid page refers to 2026–27 forms, so do not assume those forms apply to a later entry year. Midyear report and optional interview dates are separate.

aid.value: Connecticut College meets institutionally assessed demonstrated need for admitted students regardless of citizenship. International aid seekers submit CSS Profile; every international applicant also submits Verification of Financial Support in the applicant portal. The aid office describes packages as grants, loans and part-time employment, and reassesses family eligibility annually. This is not a universal full-cost grant or proof of need-blind admission. Aid and admission pages disagree on early-round dates: confirm the separate deadlines before applying.

attributes.aidShort: Meets assessed need; CSS plus Verification of Financial Support

evidence.quote: meets demonstrated need for all admitted students regardless of citizenship

english.value: Applicants educated outside the US provide official TOEFL, IELTS or DET results. TOEFL around 100, IELTS 7 and DET 130 describe successful applicants, not fixed cutoffs; no new-scale TOEFL conversion is published here. First-year waiver requests are available after admission application for native English speakers at home or three completed high-school years taught primarily in English. An approved waiver may still trigger further evidence. Agency reports are preferred; school-counsellor submission is permitted if agency delivery creates a financial burden. The college offers no ESL programme.

evidence.quote: completed three full years at a high school

deadline.value: The international checklist lists EA/ED I application and aid November 1, and ED II/RD January 15, without an entry year. However, the financial-aid page explicitly preparing for 2027–28 lists EA/ED I aid November 16, 2026 and ED II/RD January 15, 2027. These are not one consistent early-round aid deadline. Confirm both admission and financial forms with the offices. Non-US citizens are not admitted as first-year spring entrants; the November spring deadline is for transfer applicants.

aid.value: International merit/need scholarships are highly competitive, usually $10,000–$25,000/year, renewable subject to satisfactory academic progress. This is not a full-cost guarantee. Complete the free SLC International Student Financial Aid Application through the portal and supply translated family income evidence. Forms become available 2–3 business days after Common App; receipt within ten days of the application deadline has no adverse impact. Failure to complete aid requirements makes students ineligible for funding during all four years.

fee.value: Sarah Lawrence's own Common App profile lists no first-year application fee. This concerns undergraduate application, not fees for master's programmes, early childhood education or study abroad.

evidence.quote: Charges no application fee - First Year

deadline.value: First-year EA and ED I applications November 1; ED II and RD January 15. ED is binding and requires parent/counsellor signatures. Optional interview deadlines are November 10 for EA/ED I, January 19 for ED II and January 31 for RD. International aid forms follow those rounds with the ten-day document window on the international aid page. Generic FAFSA instructions apply only to eligible applicants, not ordinary international aid applications. No entry year is labelled.

evidence.quote: Early Decision II January 15 Common Application due

aid.value: Dickinson is need-aware for international admission. Its current first-year checklist explicitly caps international need-based funding at tuition; do not promise coverage of housing or all expenses. Aid seekers submit CSS Profile plus Certification of Finances, while all international applicants submit CoF. Mandatory insurance and one-time fees are excluded from need calculations. Merit awards are considered without a separate application. General full-need marketing must not override the specific international tuition cap.

attributes.aidShort: Need-aware; international need-based aid capped at tuition

evidence.quote: not to exceed the cost of tuition

fee.value: Dickinson's Common App first-year profile currently lists no application fee, consistent with the college's announcement that it removed the fee. The older 2024–25 Common Data Set lists $65 and is not used as the current application fee. Check the actual application before paying any charge.

evidence.quote: Charges no application fee - First Year

deadline.value: First-year ED I and EA applications/aid November 15; ED II and RD January 15. RD may switch to ED II with an agreement by January 28. International aid uses CSS Profile/CoF, not generic federal FAFSA eligibility. The page explicitly says there is no Spring 2027 first-year cycle: do not use its otherwise displayed October 7 spring date. Confirm the intended fall entry year, which is not labelled in the round table.

evidence.quote: There will not be a spring 2027 first-year admissions cycle.
